I need to make a decision in Monopoly.

I just completed a trade with p1. I now own INDIANA_AVENUE and MARVIN_GARDENS for $750 cash. p1 has $1,156 and owns several properties including NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE. p2 has $1,129 and owns MEDITERRANEAN_AVENUE and PACIFIC_AVENUE.

p3 has $1,435 and owns ST_CHARLES_PLACE, PENNSYLVANIA_RAILROAD, and WATER_WORKS. p2 appears to be visiting jail. Several properties remain unowned, including BALTIC, READING RR, ORIENTAL, CONNECTICUT, ELECTRIC COMPANY, STATES, VIRGINIA, TENNESSEE, NY AVE, KENTUCKY, ILLINOIS, ATLANTIC, VENTNOR, PENNSYLVANIA AVE, PARK PLACE, and BOARDWALK. The color groups are now mapped: brown is split between p2 and an unowned Baltic, light blue includes Oriental, Vermont, and Connecticut, and pink includes St Charles, States, and Virginia.

Orange, red, yellow, green, and dark blue groups are mapped. I have no monopolies and cannot build. The trade was poorly strategic: I paid $400 plus a green for two incomplete properties.

I should preserve cash to buy Kentucky and Illinois for a red monopoly, and Atlantic and Ventnor for a yellow one. Both would be strong additions.

I cannot afford all four target properties at once, so I will keep cash liquid. Mortgaging is unnecessary because these properties have no houses and rent is low. No other player owns red or yellow pieces, so trading is not an option. I should buy the remaining unowned red and yellow properties from the bank.

Completing the green group would be too expensive. I am now considering trading one of my properties plus cash to finish a color.

I will end the turn. Indiana and Marvin are my only paths to monopolies, so trading them away is not an option. I need to keep the full $750 cash intact for the next bank purchases.
